<!-- Short release notes the Daeva Discord bot posts when a release is published.
     Update "version" and the lists with each release. -->
version: 0.5.4
tagline: A fresh look for Solo, class icons, and a party queue bar that works while you fight. Updates itself from 0.5.2 on.

## New
- 🪪 **Solo idle card:** next event with a live countdown (or your last fight), your Odyle, and your combat power before the first pull
- 🛡️ **Class icons and colours** for every class
- 👥 **Party queue bar:** queue for a dungeon while you fight, with *Ready 3/4* above the boss card
- 🖼️ **Boss skill icons** and 30 more boss skill names, with skill names from [aion2.gg](https://aion2.gg)

## Fixed
- 🔔 Event cards no longer stop showing after a few hours
- 🏷️ Names after entering a dungeon, and your own name after a restart
- ⚔️ Boss fights no longer split when an add dies (Tetrata, Bakarma, Siliator)
- 🧭 Party panel: no stale *Entering* in town, and it clears when you leave
